notes: BF16-R reference uses BF16-rounded R and X0 computed from original R.
FP32-R reference uses original FP32 R and the same X0 computed from original R.
FP32-R L=32 keeps block 8 and moves only R to explicit DRAM placement.
Raw launch samples, fingerprints, correctness metrics, and sanitized telemetry are retained.
No host name or user-specific absolute path is included in this record.
The first FP32-R launch used Watcher with an external 60-second cap and completed normally before the comparison run.
The comparison run used device 1 on the host; the container exposed that board as visible device_id=0.
No reset was required. Device 0 was not used by this run.

host_accounting.accounting_scope: Board-free host preflight: CB pages, resident tensors, largest assigned core, and static L1 prefix.

comparison_conclusions.metric_reference: The comparison is against the true inverse of the original FP32 R; matching-reference metrics remain in each row.
comparison_conclusions.beam_pattern_note: The same-array beam-pattern relative-error metric did not improve for FP32-R in either size in this run; it is evidence, not a gate.
comparison_conclusions.throughput_note: FP32-R L32 uses explicit R-in-DRAM placement because block-8 R-in-L1 is rejected by host preflight; throughput is not a same-placement comparison for that row.
